Messages.Author: o r o s @umich.edu David Wilson
Messages.Body:
Hello All,

I wanted to make sure that counters(not on cards) are controlled by the
Methuselah who has them, examples I can think of are Sabbat Threat and
Deploy the Hand. If the Methuselah who put them in play is ousted do they
stay in play?

thanks,
David Wilson

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
"David Wilson" <d o r o s @ u m i c h . e d u> expounded:


"methuselah gets 1 counter" implies to me that they are controlled by
the methuselah getting them (at any rate not controlled by anyone else)
and so do not leave the game while that methuselah is in (unless they
burn the edge or whatever)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. By default, counters are controlled by the Methuselah who has them
or the controller of the card the counter is on.
